Transformers.js 4.3.2 (Hugging Face, Apache-2.0) + ONNX Runtime Web 1.31.0-dev.20260914 (Microsoft, MIT).
The runtime file ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm is split into .part1 and .part2 (each under the 25 MB upload limit); ai-worker.js joins them.
ai-worker.js is ai-worker.src.js bundled with esbuild. Models download from huggingface.co on first use and are cached by the browser.
